"""Join finite source-inferred classes to complete own/public trace roles."""
import argparse
import copy
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path('docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-join-20261006')
CHECKS = Path('docs/audits/class-frame-join-checks-20261006')
PRIOR = Path('docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-admission-20261006')
PRIOR_CHECKS = Path('docs/audits/class-frame-admission-checks-20261006')
REVISION = '0373153be5fc564797d75f07928d1df4b0bd6be2'
TASK = Path('docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md')
OWNER = 'SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.60.4.3.3.5.2.1.5.2.2.3.1.2.1.3.1.2.3.2.3.3.3.3.2.3.2.3.3.2.3.2.2.2.6.2'
SUCCESS = 'PASS complete finite source-inferred class/frame associations, whole original body/phase/operand joins and genuine separating controls; native/private/formatter/coordinate/address meanings remain open.\n'


def module(path):
    ns = {'__name__': 'class_frame_join_dependency', '__file__': str(path)}
    exec(compile(path.read_bytes(), str(path), 'exec'), ns)
    return ns


admission = module(PRIOR / 'verify.py')
classes = module(Path('docs/audits/record-value-original-class-20261005/verify.py'))
public = module(Path('docs/audits/record-value-public-boundary-join-20261006/verify.py'))
model = module(BASE / 'model.py')
require, same, identity, load, whole = (admission[k] for k in ('require', 'same', 'identity', 'load', 'whole'))


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        require(same(load(path), value), 'whole immutable class/frame join product: ' + name)
    else:
        require(not (BASE / 'manifest.json').exists(), 'sealed class/frame join cannot add products')
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')


def members():
    return {str(Path(p).relative_to(BASE)): pin for p, pin in whole(BASE).items() if Path(p) != BASE / 'manifest.json'}


def binding():
    roots = sorted({Path(p) for p in load(PRIOR / 'binding.json')['inputs']} | {PRIOR, PRIOR_CHECKS}, key=str)
    # Reuse the qualified streaming regular-member census at this slice's
    # committed prerequisite revision. This namespace is private to this load.
    admission['REVISION'] = REVISION
    inputs = admission['committed_inputs'](roots)
    task = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', REVISION + ':' + str(TASK)])
    return dict(revision=REVISION, inputs=inputs, task_identity=identity(task),
        owners=admission['owner_rows'](roots, task.decode()),
        original_capture=load(PRIOR / 'binding.json')['original_capture'],
        scope='Whole completed admission, original raw domain and every admitted source/programme/result member; no original recapture.')


def source_models():
    wanted = model['derive'](classes, public, require, same)
    require(same(wanted, load(BASE / 'source-models.json')), 'whole independently retained source associations before new original intake')
    actual = load(CHECKS / 'source-derivation.json')
    require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0
        and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', 'python3', '-B', str(CHECKS / 'derive_source.py')]
        and actual['stdout'].endswith('PASS qualified source associations retained before new original intake; predecessor serialized operands are opaque evidence and the initial terminal has no invented receipt.\n')
        and re.fullmatch(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr']) is not None
        and set(actual['instruments']) == {str(CHECKS / 'run.py'), str(CHECKS / 'derive_source.py'), 'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh'}
        and all(same(pin, identity(Path(p).read_bytes())) for p, pin in actual['instruments'].items()),
        'actual pre-intake qualified source derivation and invocation instruments')
    return wanted


def row(inventory, domain, index):
    return next(r for r in inventory['domains'][domain]['nonempty'] if r['index'] == index)


def prior_predicates(contract, native, nested):
    """Independent predecessor meanings; no new bridge association is used."""
    classes['check_models'](contract['class_modes'], contract['class_sources'])
    for wanted, observed in zip(contract['class_modes'], native, strict=True):
        require(wanted['mode'] == observed['mode'], 'prior class native mode')
        for case in wanted['cases']:
            require(row(observed, case['domain'], case['index'])['body'].splitlines()[0] == case['primary'],
                    'prior source/native primary class predicate')
    return public['check'](contract['frame_model'], contract['frame_model'], native, native, nested)


def check_contract(actual, expected):
    require(same(actual['class_sources'], expected['class_sources'])
        and same(actual['class_modes'], expected['class_modes'])
        and same(actual['frame_model'], expected['frame_model']), 'whole independently qualified class and frame source products')
    require([m['mode'] for m in actual['modes']] == [m['mode'] for m in expected['modes']], 'complete joint class/frame mode population')
    for candidate, wanted in zip(actual['modes'], expected['modes'], strict=True):
        require([(r['domain'], r['index']) for r in candidate['cases']] == [(r['domain'], r['index']) for r in wanted['cases']],
                'complete joint class/frame refusal population')
        for case, oracle in zip(candidate['cases'], wanted['cases'], strict=True):
            require(type(case['index']) is int and type(case['helper']) is int, 'joint discrete source allocation kinds')
            require(same(case['exception'], oracle['exception']), 'source exception class/primary/family to frame-case association')
            require([p['phase'] for p in case['phases']] == [p['phase'] for p in oracle['phases']]
                and all(type(p['phase']) is int for p in case['phases']), 'ordered complete source class/frame throw phases')
            for phase, source in zip(case['phases'], oracle['phases'], strict=True):
                require(phase['family'] == model['family'](phase['own']['core'][0]['function'], require)
                    == source['family'] and same(phase['guard_source'], source['guard_source']),
                    'source guard family to active throw-phase association')
                require(phase['inferred_class'] == case['exception']['inferred_class'] == classes['CLASS']
                    and phase['native_class'] == source['native_class'], 'source-inferred scalar class without native promotion')
                require([f['function'] for f in phase['own']['core']] == [f['function'] for f in source['own']['core']],
                    'complete source class/frame phase function order')
                require([f['arguments'] for f in phase['own']['core']] == [f['arguments'] for f in source['own']['core']],
                    'complete source class/frame phase argument roles')
                require(same(phase['own'], source['own']) and same(phase['public'], source['public']),
                    'whole source class/frame operation helper body public entry and load roles')
            require(case['exception']['source_family'] == case['phases'][-1]['family'],
                    'final source exception class belongs to final own throw phase')
    require(same(actual, expected), 'whole independent class/frame source contract and explicit evidence scope')


def check(actual, expected, native, original, nested):
    check_contract(actual, expected)
    prior = prior_predicates(expected, native, nested)
    result = []
    for wanted, observed, joined in zip(expected['modes'], native, prior['own_join']['contexts'], strict=True):
        keys = {(domain, r['index']) for domain, values in observed['domains'].items() for r in values['nonempty']}
        require(keys == {(r['domain'], r['index']) for r in wanted['cases']}, 'every complete original refusal has a source class/frame association')
        api_models = next(m for m in expected['frame_model']['own']['api'] if m['mode'] == wanted['mode'])
        cases = []
        for case, path in zip(wanted['cases'], joined['cases'], strict=True):
            require((case['domain'], case['index']) == (path['domain'], path['index']), 'complete source/native class/frame case linkage')
            record = row(observed, case['domain'], case['index'])
            require(type(record['body']) is str and record['wire_kind'] == 'string', 'source class and original serialized body wire kind')
            require(record['body'].startswith(case['exception']['primary'] + '\n'), 'complete source-primary to original body header association')
            require(len(path['phases']) == len(case['phases']), 'whole original class/frame throw-phase population')
            frames = [s for s in record['segments'] if s['kind'] == 'frame']
            phases = []
            for source, positions in zip(case['phases'], path['phases'], strict=True):
                first = positions['core_positions'][0]
                require(model['family'](public['context']['function'](frames[first]), require) == source['family'],
                        'whole original active frame and inferred throw-family linkage')
                phases.append(dict(phase=source['phase'], family=source['family'], inferred_class=source['inferred_class'],
                    guard_source=source['guard_source'], complete_own_positions=positions,
                    native_class='not measured; qualified source/publisher inference only'))
            forwarded = None
            if len(case['phases']) == 2:
                require(case['domain'] == 'api' and [p['family'] for p in case['phases']] == ['metadata', 'value'],
                        'source nested Metadata catch and new Value throw roles')
                operation = next(r for r in api_models['cases'] if r['index'] == case['index'])
                allocation = operation['nested_allocation']
                require(allocation is not None and allocation['scope_api'] == case['index'], 'complete source nested class/frame allocation')
                child = row(observed, 'api', allocation['capture_api'])
                child_case = next(r for r in wanted['cases'] if r['domain'] == 'api' and r['index'] == allocation['capture_api'])
                # The model's explicit root-context role is in the inherited
                # _validate_type frame, not necessarily core[-2]. Select it
                # by its source-declared semantic role, never a trace address.
                contexts = [a['value'] for f in case['phases'][0]['own']['core'] for a in f['arguments'] if a.get('role') == 'root_context']
                require(len(contexts) == 1, 'unique source nested root-context role')
                context = contexts[0]
                prefix = classes['GUARDS']['value'][1] + context + ' has invalid resolved type: ' + child['body'] + '\n'
                require(child_case['exception']['source_family'] == 'metadata'
                    and child['body'].startswith(child_case['exception']['primary'] + '\n')
                    and record['body'].startswith(prefix), 'whole serialized inner operand joins Metadata class/frame to outer Value body')
                require(bool(record['body'][len(prefix):]), 'separate nonempty new Value throw trace')
                forwarded = dict(capture_api=allocation['capture_api'], scope_api=allocation['scope_api'], context=context,
                    inner_body=child['body_identity'], entire_outer_prefix=identity(prefix.encode()),
                    new_outer_trace=identity(record['body'][len(prefix):].encode()),
                    meaning='whole operand conservation and source catch/interpolation/new-throw relation; original formatter and hook identities are not inferred')
            cases.append(dict(domain=case['domain'], index=case['index'], helper=case['helper'], kind=case['kind'],
                exception=case['exception'], original_whole_body=record['body_identity'], phases=phases, forwarded=forwarded,
                public=next(r for r in next(m for m in prior['modes'] if m['mode'] == wanted['mode'])['cases']
                    if (r['domain'], r['index']) == (case['domain'], case['index'])),
                opaque_frames=path['opaque_frames']))
        result.append(dict(mode=wanted['mode'], cases=cases))
    require(same(native, original), 'every canonical original raw body allocation context and opaque byte conserves')
    return dict(modes=result, full_prior_public_join=prior,
        scope='Complete finite own class/frame/source/body/phase/argument associations and public compatibility; original native class/provider/hooks/private framework/formatter/hidden arguments/coordinates/address lifetimes remain unmeasured.')


def controls(expected, original, nested):
    output = []
    def refuse(name, candidate, native, cause, prior=True):
        require(not (same(candidate, expected) and same(native, original)), 'genuine class/frame join intervention: ' + name)
        if prior:
            prior_predicates(candidate, native, nested)
        try:
            check(candidate, expected, native, original, nested)
        except ValueError as error:
            require(str(error) == cause, 'intended class/frame join refusal: ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
            output.append(dict(control=name, status=1, cause=cause,
                prior_predicates='complete independent class and public frame predicates passed in intervention epoch' if prior else 'not asserted',
                intervention='new source-association bridge; predecessor products intact' if native is original else 'whole raw operand relation; predecessor own/public meanings intact'))
        else:
            raise ValueError('false-green independent class/frame join: ' + name)
    def altered(name, mutate, cause):
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(expected); mutate(candidate)
        refuse(name, candidate, original, cause)
    first = expected['modes'][0]['cases'][0]
    other = next(c for c in expected['modes'][0]['cases'] if c['exception']['source_family'] != first['exception']['source_family'])
    altered('cross-family-class-frame-association', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'][0].update(exception=copy.deepcopy(other['exception'])),
            'source exception class/primary/family to frame-case association')
    nested_case = next(i for i,c in enumerate(expected['modes'][0]['cases']) if len(c['phases']) == 2)
    altered('reversed-source-throw-phases', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'][nested_case]['phases'].reverse(),
            'ordered complete source class/frame throw phases')
    altered('wrong-phase-guard-family', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'][0]['phases'][0].update(family='metadata'),
            'source guard family to active throw-phase association')
    altered('reordered-source-core-functions', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'][0]['phases'][0]['own']['core'].reverse(),
            'complete source class/frame phase function order')
    altered('wrong-source-core-argument', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'][0]['phases'][0]['own']['core'][0]['arguments'][1].update(value='borrowed'),
            'complete source class/frame phase argument roles')
    altered('lost-class-frame-refusal', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'].pop(), 'complete joint class/frame refusal population')
    altered('native-class-promotion', lambda m:m['modes'][0]['cases'][0]['phases'][0].update(inferred_class='blessed_HASH'),
            'source-inferred scalar class without native promotion')
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(original)
    operation = next(c for c in expected['frame_model']['own']['api'][0]['cases'] if c['index'] == expected['modes'][0]['cases'][nested_case]['index'])
    child = row(candidate[0], 'api', operation['nested_allocation']['capture_api'])
    parts = [s['raw'] for s in child['segments']]
    i = next(i for i,s in enumerate(child['segments']) if s['kind'] == 'frame' and s['call'] == 'eval {...}' and '/Test/Builder.pm' in s['path'])
    parts[i] = parts[i].replace('eval {...}', 'eval {OPAQUE}', 1)
    body = ''.join(parts); require(body != child['body'], 'genuine opaque inner operand byte mutation')
    trace = public['context']['module'](public['context']['RAW'] / 'trace_inventory.py')['inventory']
    child.update(body=body, body_identity=identity(body.encode()), **trace(body))
    refuse('inner-operand-no-longer-forwarded-whole', expected, candidate,
           'whole serialized inner operand joins Metadata class/frame to outer Value body')
    return output


def prerequisite_replay(fresh):
    name = 'admission-replay.json'; command = ['python3', '-B', str(PRIOR / 'verify.py')]
    if fresh:
        require(not (CHECKS / name).exists(), 'actual prerequisite replay cannot overwrite')
        instruments = {p:identity(Path(p).read_bytes()) for p in (str(PRIOR / 'verify.py'), 'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh')}
        p = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True)
        (CHECKS / name).write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command, status=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout.decode(), stderr=p.stderr.decode(), instruments=instruments), sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
    actual = load(CHECKS / name)
    require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0 and actual['command'] == command
        and actual['stdout'] == admission['SUCCESS'] and actual['stderr'] == ''
        and set(actual['instruments']) == {str(PRIOR / 'verify.py'), 'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh'}
        and all(same(pin, identity(Path(p).read_bytes())) for p,pin in actual['instruments'].items()),
        'actual complete admission replay; saved transitive native roles remain explicit')
    return dict(actual=identity((CHECKS / name).read_bytes()), role='Fresh full admission/custody/raw/control/saved-result execution; eight prior reader processes and original native captures retained, not recaptured.')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--prepare', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--seal', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(not (args.prepare and args.seal), 'source/admission preparation is not a semantic seal')
    if (BASE / 'manifest.json').exists():
        require(not args.prepare, 'sealed join cannot prepare or recapture')
        require(same(load(BASE / 'manifest.json'), members()), 'whole immutable class/frame join seal')
    expected = source_models()
    before = binding(); save('binding.json', before)
    save('prerequisite-proof.json', prerequisite_replay(args.prepare and not (CHECKS / 'admission-replay.json').exists()))
    raw = admission['raw_product'](); save('raw-product.json', raw)
    native = raw['inventories']
    nested = public['context']['nested_records'](expected['frame_model']['own'])
    save('proofs.json', check(expected, expected, native, native, nested))
    save('controls.json', controls(expected, native, nested))
    require(same(binding(), before), 'every complete committed prerequisite byte conserves after semantic join')
    if not args.prepare:
        book = module(BASE / 'book.py')
        save('book-proof.json', book['proof']((BASE / 'book-input.html').read_text()))
    if args.seal:
        save('manifest.json', members())
    print(SUCCESS, end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Mutable external gate receipts with durable streams and complete programme epochs."""
import fcntl
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def update(name, row, replace=False):
    lock_path = local(Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-admission-20261011/checks.lock'), exists=False)
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        records = load('checks.json') if (BASE / 'checks.json').exists() else {}
        need((name in records) == replace, 'retain first complete gate receipt')
        records[name] = row
        (BASE / 'checks.json').write_bytes(canonical(records))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'named explicit gate command')
    name, command = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
    need(name and all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in name), 'closed gate receipt label')
    folder = local(Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-admission-20261011/checks') / name, exists=False)
    need(not folder.exists(), 'fresh complete gate stream directory')
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    epoch = programs()
    inputs = {path: row['identity'] for path, row in epoch.items()}
    for arg in command:
        if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file():
            inputs[arg] = pin(local(arg).read_bytes())
    for path in ('scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', 'scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
                 'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py', 'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md',
                 'docs/knowledge/record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md'):
        inputs[path] = pin(local(path).read_bytes())
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, inputs=inputs, stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
                   outcome='started; missing terminal result is non-success')
    update(name, started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    after = {path: pin(local(path).read_bytes()) for path in inputs}
    record = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_bytes().decode(), stderr=stderr.read_bytes().decode(),
                  inputs_after=after, epoch_conserved=inputs == after)
    update(name, record, replace=True)
    print(name, result.returncode, record['stdout'][-1800:], record['stderr'][-1800:], flush=True)
    need(after == inputs, 'whole gate programme/source epoch conserved')
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0, 'actual successful external gate: ' + name)

"""Publish only completed admission; raw semantic association stays pending."""
import base64
import copy
import gzip
import re
from pathlib import Path
from common import *
import run
import verify

SURFACES = 'doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl'
BOOK = 'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md'


def authority(before, task_sources, book_sources, book_after):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in before.splitlines()]
    measured = metrics(task_sources)['metrics']
    for row in rows:
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'task_evidence':
            need(row['state'] == 'warning_debt' and measured['lines_each'] < 7200, 'owned warning-debt work before rollover')
            for key, value in measured.items():
                need(value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key], 'unchanged task ceilings')
                row['transition']['max_growth'][key] = max(0, value + row['transition']['ratchet_step'][key] - row['baseline'][key])
        elif row.get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior':
            baseline = metrics(book_sources)['metrics']
            current = dict(book_sources)
            current[BOOK] = book_after
            after = metrics(current)['metrics']
            keys = ('files', 'bytes_total', 'lines_total')
            row['reference_contract']['aggregate_change'] = dict(authority_id='RAW-SEMANTIC-ADMISSION-20261011',
                owner=OWNER, baseline={key: baseline[key] for key in keys},
                delta={key: after[key]-baseline[key] for key in keys},
                rationale='Document complete fresh raw-semantic source/prerequisite admission and explicit fixed-instrument replay condition; full raw association/publication and original native/private scopes stay open.')
    return b''.join(canonical(row) for row in rows)


def main():
    actuals = verify.actual_readers()
    native_paths = sorted(BASE.glob('actual-native-census-*.json'))
    need(len(native_paths) == 1, 'complete first independent native census')
    actual = json.loads(native_paths[0].read_bytes())
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0 and actual['stderr'] == '', 'actual full native source census')
    save('native-census.json', dict(receipt=str(native_paths[0]), identity=pin(native_paths[0].read_bytes())))
    need(load('intake-before.json') == load('intake-after.json'), 'whole source condition before publication')
    topology = load('topology-controls.json')
    diagnostic = topology['cases']['changed-tail']['native']['stderr']
    locus = re.search(r' at [^\s]+ line [0-9]+', diagnostic)
    need(locus is not None, 'actual native control diagnostic locus')
    current = local(TASK).read_bytes()
    graph = verify.task_nodes(current)
    block = graph[OWNER]
    need(verify.field(block, 'Status') == 'active', 'own live admission leaf before finish')
    save('reader-summary.json', dict(readers=actuals, scope=SCOPE))
    wording = ('Whole clean 3a5229ffa source/native/product and complete predecessor namespaces authenticate byte for byte, '
        'including directory closure and the recovered coordinate archive. Every declared prerequisite reader freshly executes '
        'in its exact source or dated-instrument role; complete commands/programmes and both durable streams retain before status judgement. '
        'Independent native filesystem/source census and genuine topology/byte/missing/link/foreign/typed-result/borrowed-role controls qualify. '
        'Whole original raw contracts and every unrelated task node conserve. Source condition remains explicit; later changed publication '
        'instruments require a separately qualified complete dated checkpoint. Complete current/book/native/focused/claim/staged/normal '
        'gates require actual success before commit. Full raw association/publication and original native/private scopes remain open.')
    updated = block.replace(b'  Status: `active`\n', b'  Status: `done`\n', 1)
    updated = updated.replace(b'  Verification: `pending`\n', ('  Verification: `' + wording + '`\n').encode(), 1)
    updated = updated.replace(b'  Commit: `pending`\n', ('  Commit: `' + OWNER + ': qualify complete raw semantic admission`\n').encode(), 1)
    updated = updated.rstrip() + (f'\n  Acceptance Checklist (enforced):\n'
        f'  - [x] **ROOT CAUSE (WHY + WHERE)** — Actual whole-byte native control refuses{locus[0]}; topology-controls.json retains its complete candidate, programme-bound outcome and both streams. Fixed predecessor/source intake and unchanged raw contracts require fresh admission before full-body association.\n'
        '  - [x] **ADDRESSED (verified)** — Complete Git/current byte and directory closure, separate native census, all fresh explicit source/dated reader roles and complete durable child streams qualify. Whole original acceptance and all prior source/native/private boundaries conserve; semantic association remains pending.\n'
        '  - [x] **NO REGRESSION** — All tests successful in checks.json focused; current source/native/book publication, independent input/result controls, exact saved reader, source/claim/staged scripts/check_doctrines.sh and normal hooks require actual success before commit.\n\n').encode()
    local(TASK).write_bytes(current.replace(block, updated, 1))
    memory = local('MEMORY.md').read_text().replace(OWNER + '` (active)', OWNER.rsplit('.', 1)[0] + '.2` (pending)', 1)
    start, end = memory.index('- next_action:'), memory.index('- in_flight_uncommitted:')
    memory = memory[:start] + '- next_action: Activate independent complete raw-body association .5.2.2 from committed whole admission; preserve every source/class/frame/header/coordinate/address and inner/outer cause contract, prior meanings and original native/private gaps.\n' + memory[end:]
    local('MEMORY.md').write_text(memory)
    index = local('docs/TASK_TREE.md').read_text()
    need('raw join admission active.' in index, 'owned task-index frontier')

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-qualified.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(str(path) for path in (PRIOR,
        Path('docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisite-gate-repair-20261011'),
        Path('docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011')))
    selected.add('docs/audits/coordinate-public-route-checks-20261008/drafts.tar.gz')
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()
    save('intake-after.json' if args.after else 'intake-before.json', result)
    if args.after:
        need(result == load('intake-before.json'), 'whole input source/native/product epoch conserved across every reader')

"""Durably stream every child outcome, including interruption-time output."""
import argparse
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def execute(label, command):
    need(label and all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in label), 'closed source/result label')
    attempts = list(BASE.glob('started-' + label + '-*.json'))
    number = max((int(path.stem.rsplit('-', 1)[1]) for path in attempts), default=0) + 1
    prefix = label + '-' + str(number)
    stdout = local(BASE / (prefix + '.stdout.txt'), exists=False)
    stderr = local(BASE / (prefix + '.stderr.txt'), exists=False)
    need(not stdout.exists() and not stderr.exists(), 'retain first full child streams')
    epoch = programs()
    instruments = {arg: dict(body=(raw := local(arg).read_bytes()).decode(), identity=pin(raw))
                   for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()}
    started = dict(command=command, programs=epoch, direct_instruments=instruments,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr), owner=OWNER, source_revision=REVISION,
        scope='Pre-execution only. A missing actual result is non-success; stream files retain bytes even if the guard terminates this process tree.')
    save('started-' + prefix + '.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    out, err = stdout.read_bytes(), stderr.read_bytes()
    after = {path: pin(local(path).read_bytes()) for path in epoch | instruments}
    before = {path: row['identity'] for path, row in (epoch | instruments).items()}
    record = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=out.decode(), stderr=err.decode(),
                  stdout_identity=pin(out), stderr_identity=pin(err), inputs_after=after, epoch_conserved=before == after)
    name = 'actual-' + prefix + '.json'
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, record['stdout'][-400:], record['stderr'][-1000:], flush=True)
    # Persist full actual result before evaluating status, streams or currency.
    need(before == after, 'complete declared reader programme epoch conserved')
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0, 'actual successful child status: ' + name)
    return name, record


def qualify(record, spec):
    need(type(record.get('status')) is int and record['status'] == 0, 'actual integer reader success')
    need(record['command'] == spec['command'], 'exact complete reader command')
    need(type(record['stdout']) is str and record['stderr'] == '', 'whole clean reader streams')
    need(record['stdout'] == spec['stdout'] if spec['match'] == 'whole' else record['stdout'].endswith(spec['stdout']),
         'complete declared source or dated reader stdout role')
    need(record['epoch_conserved'] is True, 'whole reader programme conservation')
    need(type(record['programs']) is dict and set(record['programs']) == set(programs())
         and type(record['direct_instruments']) is dict and bool(record['direct_instruments']),
         'complete own reader runner and direct instrument population')
    need(record['stdout_identity'] == pin(record['stdout'].encode())
         and record['stderr_identity'] == pin(record['stderr'].encode()), 'complete durably retained actual streams')
    for path, programme in (record['programs'] | record['direct_instruments']).items():
        need(pin(programme['body'].encode()) == programme['identity'] == record['inputs_after'][path],
             'whole actual reader programme and final epoch')
    need(all(row['identity'] == programs()[path]['identity'] for path, row in record['programs'].items()),
         'exact current source of every retained own runner programme')


def specifications():
    prior = json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(PRIOR / 'readers.json')))
    result = {name: row['specification'] for name, row in prior['readers'].items()}
    checks = json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011/checks.json'))
    result['complete-prerequisite-default'] = dict(command=['python3', '-B', str(PRIOR / 'verify.py')],
        stdout=checks['prior-raw-dated']['stdout'], match='whole', authority=str(PRIOR / 'verify.py'),
        context='complete dated prerequisite acceptance; no later native/current publication currency')
    result['task-containment-dated'] = dict(command=['python3', '-B', 'docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011/verify.py'],
        stdout=checks['default-current']['stdout'], match='whole',
        authority='docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011/verify.py', context='complete retained dated task/source/registry epoch')
    result['aggregate-prerequisite-correction'] = dict(command=['python3', '-B', 'docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisite-gate-repair-20261011/verify.py'],
        stdout='PASS retained aggregate gate refusal, independent complete task-source census and exact measured allowance correction; every ceiling and Knowledge Map allowance remains unchanged.\n',
        match='whole', authority='docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisite-gate-repair-20261011/verify.py',
        context='complete dated task-source/registry correction; no later allowance currency')
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--readers', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--fresh-readers', action='store_true',
                        help='Explicitly rerun every reader; retain all earlier attempts unchanged.')
    parser.add_argument('arguments', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.readers:
        need(not args.fresh_readers, 'fresh execution requires whole-reader selection')
        need(len(args.arguments) >= 2, 'explicit named command')
        execute(args.arguments[0], args.arguments[1:])
        return
    need(not args.arguments, 'closed whole-reader selection')
    need(load('intake-before.json')['revision'] == REVISION, 'complete whole source admission before readers')
    result = {}
    specs = specifications()
    # Execute the longest complete coordinate reader last; every role still runs.
    names = sorted(specs, key=lambda name: (name == 'address-coordinate', name))
    for name in names:
        spec = specs[name]
        existing = sorted(BASE.glob('actual-reader-' + name + '-*.json'),
                          key=lambda path: int(path.stem.rsplit('-', 1)[1]))
        if existing and not args.fresh_readers:
            path = existing[-1]
            record = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
            qualify(record, spec)
        else:
            filename, record = execute('reader-' + name, spec['command'])
            path = BASE / filename
            qualify(record, spec)
        result[name] = dict(specification=spec, receipt=str(path), identity=pin(path.read_bytes()))
    save('readers.json', dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, readers=result))
    print('PASS every complete declared raw-semantic admission reader freshly executed in its explicit source or dated role; full actual programmes and both streams retain.')

def task_nodes(raw):
    marker = b'## Task Tree\n'
    need(raw.count(marker) == 1, 'unique authoritative task graph')
    section = raw.split(marker, 1)[1].split(b'\n## ', 1)[0]
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: `|\Z)', section, re.M | re.S))
    result = {match[1].decode(): match[0] for match in matches}
    need(len(result) == len(matches), 'unique authoritative task identities')
    return result


def field(raw, key):
    values = re.findall(rb'^  ' + key.encode() + rb': `([^`\n]*)`$', raw, re.M)
    need(len(values) == 1, 'whole task field ' + key)
    return values[0].decode()

    return dict(original_task=pin(source), declared_task=pin(declared), qualified_task=pin(final),
                parent_goal=field(before[parent], 'Goal'), parent_acceptance=field(before[parent], 'Acceptance'),
